explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token, I checked the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` for a case-sensitive substring match and wrapped the token’s normalized serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>`, which preserves normalized HTML output and leaves special-element contents untouched because they are not emitted as `#text` tokens.
